root_text.title: කලණ්ඩුක ජාතකය
root_text.author: A.P. de Zoysa
root_text.text:
• ඛුද්දකනිකාය
  • ජාතක
  • (පඨමො භාගො)
  • 1. එකක නිපාතය
  • 13. කුසනාළි වර්ගය

127. කලණ්ඩුක ජාතකය

Msdiv 127“ඒ දේශයෝය. ඔහු වස්තූහුය වනය ගොචරකොට ඇත්තාවූ මමද දනිමි. ස්වාමිහු තා දැනගෙණ හැරගන්නාහුය. කලණ්ඩුකය, කිරිබීම් කරවයි කීයේය.”

කලණ්ඩුකජාතකං සත්තමං.

AP de Zoysa edition.

Permission to publish was kindly granted by Kumari Jayawardhana.

Conversion from PDF was by Janaka of http://pitaka.lk/.

The assistance of Amaradasa Liyanagamage, Ven Mettavihari and Maithri Panagoda is gratefully acknowledged.

Prepared for SuttaCentral by Ayya Kathrin Vimalañāṇī.

suttaplex.blurb: “You vaunt.”—This story was told by the Master once at Jetavana, about a boastful Brother. (The introductory story and the story of the past in this case are like those of Katahaka related above.)
